abstract: Metastases to the heart are rarely diagnosed before death. In this report the authors describe what they believe is the first case of metastasis from embryonal carcinoma of the testis to the heart that was successfully removed. Nine years after orchiectomy for embryonal carcinoma of the testis a 32-year-old man was found to have a right atrial tumour. The preliminary diagnosis was myxoma, but because of his previous testicular cancer and a metastatic deposit that had been found 6 years earlier, a diagnosis of cardiac metastasis seemed more likely. The tumour, removed from the lateral wall of the right atrium, had the same histologic features as the original embryonal carcinoma and the metastatic deposit. The patient made a smooth recovery.
abstract_ja: 心臓への転移は、死亡前に診断されることが稀である。本報告では、精巣胎児性癌の心臓転移が切除に成功した初の症例と考えられるものを記載した。精巣胎児性癌に対する精巣摘除術の9年後、32歳の男性に右房腫瘍が認められた。術前診断は粘液腫であったが、6年前に転移巣が見つかっていた精巣がんの既往から、心臓転移の可能性がより高いと考えられた。右房の側壁から切除された腫瘍は、原発の胎児性癌および転移巣と同一の組織学的特徴を示した。患者は順調に回復した。
